name: Kenney Roguelike Characters (2.0)
reason: 16 px and layered, but outline-free: clashes with the dark-outlined world; its 16 px people are shorter than the game's 20×26 characters.

name: Kenney Roguelike RPG Pack
reason: 16 px, but outline-free top-down tiles in a different style from the Tiny family used for the ground.

name: Kenney Tiny Battle (1.0)
reason: Modern military (tanks, planes, team flags): not relevant to the biomes.

name: Kenney Tiny Farm (1.0)
reason: Crops and farm animals; no biome critters or NPC animals. Its trees share Tiny Town's 16 px proportion problem.

name: Kenney 1-Bit Pack
reason: Monochrome 1-bit style: can't sit beside full-colour art.

name: Kenney Micro Roguelike
reason: 8 px tiles: a different pixel density (never mixed).

name: Kenney UI Audio
reason: Downloaded and measured; Interface Sounds had a softer, shorter tap.

name: Pixel-boy & AAA: Ninja Adventure
reason: The spec's primary pack (16 px characters, monsters, bosses, animals, music). itch.io needs a browser click-through, so it can't be fetched here: see docs/quest/OWNER_ACTIONS.md.
